site: Bank of America application 140, military spouse/domestic partner question
class: Personal relationship mistaken for an employer relationship
symptom: Required military-spouse status was answered No from profile.relatives_employed_here. Community-college attendance and referral status were also present as No without established profile support.
root_cause: The employment-family question pattern accepted any partner after spouse, including domestic partner. That incorrectly applied an employment-family fact to the person's own military relationship status. The separate unsupported community-college and referral answers could not be justified by the deterministic resolver.
why_tests_missed: Family-employment tests covered company/vendor relationships but did not distinguish a person's own domestic/military relationship from a relative's job.
fix: Require employment or business context for partner in the employment-family resolver; domestic/military partner status is left unresolved without an approved answer. Preserve actual spouse employment questions. Held submission and asked the owner for the three unsupported required facts; no confirmation is assumed.
prevention: A negative answer about one relationship does not establish another personal fact. Unsupported required answers remain a review blocker.
